experiment: Confidence-aware abstention diagnostic for frozen RRF60
primary_confidence_signal: Equal-weight mean reciprocal rank of the final RRF top-1 issue under BGE, BM25, and SPLADE-ZS
tie_policy: At each target coverage, include all queries tied at the Nth confidence score; realized coverage may exceed target.
gold_usage: Gold is used only after all confidence features are computed, to measure enrichment of originally judged positive top-1 issues.
interpretation_guard: A benchmark-confirmed hit means the selected issue was one of the originally human-judged positive Häring issues. An unconfirmed top-1 is not necessarily semantically wrong because the original judgment pool is incomplete.
